verdict.rationale: Portkey's AI gateway docs make a single claim that it can 'Connect to Remote MCP servers, allowing you to connect external tools and data sources,' so the core capability is asserted. There is no detail on configuration, tool invocation, auth, or limits, so the extent of delivery is unclear. Missing for 10: setup and configuration docs for plugging in MCP servers, how discovered tools are exposed to and called by models, support for local (stdio) servers beyond remote ones, auth/permission handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
